directional_call_doc61_SS11.rationale: (a) arXiv:2509.09541 evaluates ANGLE against AMPLITUDE encoding on a compositional-generalisation task with a classical DisCoCat comparator and reports ANGLE ENCODING GENERALLY STRONGER -- a directional precedent on this exact axis.
